channels.name: Alder Construction
channels.legal_basis: UPDES general permit coverage UTG071774 (construction dewatering): the permit's noncompliance reports to DWQ
channels.note: No web channel found: Alder Construction holds a construction dewatering coverage at a sewer project; R317-801's overflow duty rests on the sewer system's owner, whose row carries it. channels.legal_basis: NPDES permit UTG589401 (EPA Region 8, tribal land): the 24-hour and five-day noncompliance reports of 40 CFR 122.41(l)(6), to EPA

Utah's rule does not apply on tribal land. (research/ut/report.md §3)

channels.name: Vernal City
channels.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R317-801-4: "A Class 1 SSO shall be reported orally within 24 hrs and with a written report submitted to the DWQ within five calendar days"; R317-801-1(13) defines a Class 1 overflow (one that reaches waters of the state, exceeds 5,000 gallons, affects more than five private structures or a public, commercial or industrial one, or may be a public health risk)
channels.note: No web channel found: Vernal City reports a Class 1 overflow to DWQ by telephone within 24 hours and in writing within five days (R317-801-4); DWQ publishes no list (ut-dwq-class-1-sso-reports). An overflow becomes public only when someone also calls DEQ's spill hotline (ut-deq-environmental-incidents). No public notice is required. (research/ut/report.md §2.1)
